name: flow_conversation
title: Flowpad conversation
description: The team conversations of a help desk's tickets, as a channel an agent can serve. It wakes the agent on a guest message that passed screening, or on a person who tags it; what the agent writes goes back into the team conversation as free text. It never wakes it on a message still pending, held or rejected, on its own words, or on a steer.

desk_project_id.label: Desk
desk_project_id.hint: The desk whose tickets' team conversations this agent works in.
